aliasing.description: Places come from rustc's expression-use visitor for writes and exclusive borrows only

dispatch.description: Static, method, dynamic and function-value dispatch from typeck; selected trait implementations from instance resolution

evaluation-order.description: Operands, assignments and branches in the order the language specifies

exceptional-flow.description: A panic ends its path; unwinding is not a transfer

implicit-calls.description: Destructors and implicit conversions are not emitted

integer-semantics.description: Integer widths and signedness are recorded where types are

macro-provenance.description: Macro-expanded and desugared nodes carry their outermost call site

mutability.description: Binding mutability from HIR binding modes

resolution.description: Paths and calls are resolved by rustc; built-in operators carry no references

types.description: Types are recorded for signatures, places and called values only

ast.description: The HIR tree with for, while and ? restored to their source shape

cfg.description: Every transfer but unwinding; a closure's body is a flow of its own and a coroutine's runs in place

method.description: Identity, spans, parameters and receiver; generics and lifetimes are not emitted

place.description: Writes and exclusive borrows from rustc's expression-use visitor

symbol.description: Bindings with their reads and writes

unit.description: Unit files with content, target and edition
